name: @aiti-ai/aiti-cpu-meter
description: Main-thread smoothness detector — a seconds counter + 0–100 smoothness score + color tiers + minimize + AI jank debugging. Ships as two artifacts: a pi-web extension (internal) and a standalone single-file injector you can register into any website you develop.
soul: 主线程一卡，读秒就停；流畅度一分，忙闲立见——挂在工作页角落，收工点开看平均。
